metadata.title: Raw oscilloscope captures for an ultrasound FSK downlink bit-error-rate measurement
metadata.description:
Fifteen oscilloscope captures of a PLL phase-rotator output carrying a 2-FSK downlink, recorded at symbol rates from 50 to 80 kbaud. Each capture holds the reference clock (SYN), the supply (VP) and the two phase-rotator pulse channels (FREQ_UP_2, FREQ_DN_2) sampled at 20 ns.

These are the raw data behind the bit-error-rate results in the accompanying paper. The decoder that turns them into bit streams, the transmitted golden frames and the decoded bit streams are in the software repository at https://github.com/cortalo/ultrasound, which also carries a SHA256SUMS manifest covering the uncompressed captures and a get_captures.sh that downloads this record and verifies it.

Files are xz-compressed CSV. Decompress with xz -d *.csv.xz, then check against SHA256SUMS in the repository.
